notes: Gasoline fleet. Play is probe → finding → call the fix. Only core items are required.

cases.title: Dead after the trailer
cases.hint: Cheap stuff first. Gas and the kill switch. Don't start with the engine.

cart.notes: Older Club Car utility. Just came off an enclosed Trailer Transit load.

cases.ticket: Unloaded this morning off the enclosed trailer. Key is on. Pedal goes down and the engine never turns over. Fuel gauge is sitting on empty.
cases.cause: Tank is empty and the kill switch was left off after unload. Fill it, switch on, it fires.
cases.still: Pedal down, the engine still doesn't turn over.

checks.label: Check the gas
checks.finding: Gauge is on empty. Tank is dry.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue.

checks.label: Check the kill switch
checks.finding: Kill switch is off.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue.

checks.label: Put gas in it
checks.finding: Tank's full now.
checks.after: Pedal down — engine still doesn't turn over.

checks.label: Fill it and turn the kill switch on
checks.finding: Gas in it, kill switch on. It starts and idles.

forbidden.label: That's an engine swap for a dry tank.

cases.title: Cranks, never fires
cases.hint: It cranks and it smells like gas. Next question is spark.
cases.setting: Charlotte shop. Came back from last weekend.
cases.ticket: Engine cranks but never starts. You can smell raw gas around the carb. Operator has been trying to start it over and over.
cases.cause: Fouled spark plug. They flooded it. New plug, stop cranking.
cases.still: It still cranks and never fires.

checks.label: Pull the spark plug
checks.finding: Plug is wet and black. Fouled.
checks.after: That's the problem. Now change it.

checks.label: Check for spark
checks.finding: Weak spark on a dirty plug. Plug is the problem, not the coil.

checks.label: Put a new plug in
checks.finding: New plug in. It fires on the first try.

forbidden.label: The engine is spinning. It's a plug.

cases.title: Starts, then dies
cases.hint: It has just enough fuel to start. After that the line is starving.

cart.notes: Sat a couple weeks after the last event.

cases.ticket: Starts on the first try, runs about ten seconds, then dies. Restarts every time. Same cycle if you keep doing it.
cases.cause: Stale gas and a clogged fuel filter. Fresh fuel and a new filter.
cases.still: It still starts, runs about ten seconds, then dies.

checks.label: Check the fuel filter
checks.finding: Filter is dark and barely passing fuel.
checks.after: That's a big part of it. Gas may still be stale.

checks.label: Check how old the gas is
checks.finding: Gas smells like varnish. It's been sitting.
checks.after: That's only part of the issue. The filter can still be clogged.

checks.label: Put fresh gas in
checks.finding: Fresh gas in it.
checks.after: It still dies after about ten seconds. Something in the line is still starving it.

checks.label: New filter and fresh gas
checks.finding: New filter, fresh gas. It holds a long idle and a test loop.

forbidden.label: Don't throw a carb before the filter.

cases.title: Oil all over the side
cases.hint: Find the leak, but check the stick first so you don't run it dry.

cart.notes: Real writeup: oil leak side gasket.

cases.setting: After TSS. Sitting in the out-of-service row.
cases.ticket: Oil on the left side of the engine and a drip under the cart on the trailer. They drove it in anyway.
cases.cause: Side case gasket. Check oil, replace the gasket, refill. Don't send it leaking.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Oil is down. Not empty yet.

checks.label: Find the leak
checks.finding: It's weeping from the side case gasket, not the drain plug.

checks.label: Replace the gasket and refill
checks.finding: Gasket replaced, oil refilled. No drip on the next start.

forbidden.label: Don't send a leaker to the next event.

cases.title: It sounds like rocks in a can
cases.hint: Knocking motor. Oil, then shut it down. Don't keep driving it.
cases.setting: Kansas. They dropped it at the track.
cases.ticket: Cart runs, but there's a knock from inside the engine. It got louder crossing the lot.
cases.cause: Internal knock. Check oil, shut it off, tag it out. Not a carb job.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Oil is on the stick. This isn't a dry motor. The knock is still there.

checks.label: Shut it down and tag it out
checks.finding: You kill it and tag it out of service. Right call. This one doesn't go back in the row.

forbidden.label: A knock is not a carb.

cases.title: Valor dies after it gets hot
cases.hint: EX1 heat-soaks. Look at the driver's-side screen and the cooling fins.
cases.setting: Iowa infield. Suite shuttles in the sun.
cases.ticket: Runs about 20 minutes, then loses power and dies. Restarts after it sits. Driver-side rear of the engine is packed with dirt.
cases.cause: Clogged CVT cooling screen and dirty fins. Clean them. Not a new engine.
cases.still: After it gets hot it still dies.

checks.label: Check the CVT / cooling screen
checks.finding: Driver-side CVT screen is packed solid with dirt.

checks.label: Check the cooling fins
checks.finding: Fins are caked. No air getting through.

checks.label: Clean the fins and screen
checks.finding: Screen and fins are clear. After a hot test loop it holds power.

forbidden.label: Don't replace an EX1 because it's dirty.

cases.title: Valor won't crank
cases.hint: This is an ISG cart. Check 12V first, then the ISG — not a car starter.
cases.ticket: Key on, lights work, engine will not crank. They jumped it off another cart and it still will not crank.
cases.cause: ISG controller. Battery was fine. Updated controller, not a starter motor.
cases.still: Lights work. It still will not crank.

checks.label: Check the 12V battery
checks.finding: Battery is 12.6V. Cables are clean. Jumping it did nothing because the battery isn't the problem.

checks.label: ISG controller
checks.finding: ISG controller is dead. New updated unit in, it cranks.

forbidden.label: Valor doesn't take a regular starter.

cases.title: Engine screams, cart crawls
cases.hint: Motor is making power. The belt isn't taking it to the axle.
cases.ticket: Fine around the compound. Halfway up the suite hill the engine revs and the cart barely moves. You can smell belt.
cases.cause: Glazed drive belt. Replace the belt. Engine is fine.
cases.still: Engine still revs and the cart barely moves.

checks.label: Look at the drive belt
checks.finding: Belt is glazed and shiny. That's the smell.

checks.label: Check the clutches
checks.finding: Clutches look serviceable. Belt is the worn part.

checks.label: Put a new belt on
checks.finding: New belt on. It pulls the hill without screaming.

forbidden.label: The engine is revving. That's not a dead motor.

cases.title: Pulls left after offload
cases.hint: Engine is fine. Get under the front and look.

cart.notes: Off a Sun Valley at Richmond.

cases.ticket: Pulls hard left as soon as you start rolling. Engine sounds fine. They only drove it off the trailer about 40 feet.
cases.cause: Bent tie rod from the strap or unload. Mechanical.

checks.label: Inspect the steering
checks.finding: Left tie rod is bent. Looks like a strap or a hit on the way off.

checks.label: Replace the tie rod
checks.finding: New tie rod on. It tracks straight.

forbidden.label: Don't tear into the engine for a pull.

cases.title: It shut off and the light's on
cases.hint: Believe the oil light. Don't jump it.
cases.ticket: Died in the alley. Low oil / fuel light is on. Operator wants it jumped so they can keep using it.
cases.cause: Low oil. These engines shut down on purpose. Fill it, find the leak.
cases.still: The light is still on. It still won't stay running.

checks.label: Check the oil
checks.finding: Stick is almost dry. That's why it died.

checks.label: Find the leak
checks.finding: Slow weep at the side gasket. That's where the oil went.

checks.label: Add oil and park it until the leak is fixed
checks.finding: Oil filled. You keep it out of the row until the gasket is done.
